scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Aadharbhut Shiksha Prashikshan Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: The applicant must be a registered construction worker with at least one year of regular membership in the Board.
Benefit is limited to the first two children of the registered worker.
The first two children must possess the minimum qualification prescribed for the respective competitive examination.
benefits_summary: Free coaching assistance for admission to 6th and 9th classes.
